description: Spam signal for a US/Canada number from areacode.fyi: the UNVERIFIED crowd-sourced community signal ('low' = looked up, 'mid'/'high' = user reports) PLUS public FTC Do Not Call complaint data when present (complaint count, % robocalls, top subject, date range). Caller ID can be spoofed — none of this proves a number is currently fraudulent.
name: check_number_reputation
title: Check a number's community + FTC spam signal
